title: You can't just vibe code a game
author: xaeru
selftext:
https://i.redd.it/7zhkoo53tk3i1.png

I’ve been building a 3D game with AI assistance, and I’m honestly feeling defeated looking at my progress. It made me realize that **you truly can't just vibe code a game.** People actually shipping good-looking games with AI are not vibe coding.
